rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an official record of a student's courses and grades.

example.english: When I applied to be an exchange student, I also had to submit my university transcript.
example.traditional: 我申請交換生嗰陣，要交埋大學成績單。

rows.note: Use this for a written record of spoken words, especially when the speech is transcribed word for word.

example.english: The reporter turned the interview into a transcript so the editor could check it.
example.traditional: 記者將訪問內容整理成逐字稿，方便編輯核對。
